verdict.rationale: Fern's docs say it automatically generates and hosts a production-ready MCP server for every documentation site with Ask Fern enabled. That server connects readers' AI clients (Claude Code, Cursor, Windsurf) to the site's documentation as an external data source, which is the core of the story. Availability depends on Ask Fern being enabled, and the docs never break down which tools the server exposes. missing for 10: explicit documentation of search versus page-content retrieval tools, independent or hands-on corroboration that the server works, clarity on whether it is available without Ask Fern.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, my published docs site exposes its own MCP server that my users' agents can query for search and page content

citations.quote: Fern automatically generates and hosts a production-ready Model Context Protocol (MCP) server for every documentation site with Ask Fern enabled.

The server connects AI clients like Claude Code, Cursor, and Windsurf to your documentation as an external data source, so your readers can get instant answers about your product directly within their development environment.
